messages:
maria (AE): Hey team — kicking off the POC scoping thread for Dr. Patel at Meridian Health. They want a 4-week POC, HIPAA + GDPR constraints, and a pass/fail eval. Can we align on ask list?
jon (sales_eng): Quick summary from the demo: they need redaction on PHI, in-region data residency (eu-west-1), and a signed DPA/BAA before we send any logs.
sophie (solutions): For success criteria propose: 1) mean latency P95 < 300ms for 512-token-prompt, 2) throughput 25 reqs/s sustained, 3) NER-based PHI redaction >= 95% on our eval set, 4) no PII leakage in 1000 prompt adversarial set. Agree?
maria (AE): Sounds reasonable. Dr. Patel requested an accuracy bar for clinical note extraction — they want 90% F1 on a 200-example test set.
kevin (security): From security side we need: SOC2 Type II report (or SOC2 summary), network diagram, list of subprocessors, encryption-in-transit + at-rest details, and confirmation of KMS integration. Also need to confirm whether we can support a BAA; if not signed, we cannot process PHI.
lina (legal): We can provide our standard DPA. BAA is separate — need AE to capture which data types will be stored. If they insist on on-prem, we can enable Private deployment but that changes timeline and pricing.
dr.patel (customer): Hi — we must have BAA for any PHI. Prefer hosted if data can stay in EU. Also need a short penalty clause if data exfiltration occurs. Timeline: want POC start Apr 4, 4 weeks. Is that feasible?
jon (sales_eng): Hosted EU region is fine. We can lock data residency to eu-west-1 and disable cross-region backups for the POC. Pen-test: do you want us to run internal pentest or allow customer pentest?
dr.patel (customer): We'd like to run our pen-test and a 3rd-party scan. We'll share scope soon. Need a short window to test (48h) near week 3.
kevin (security): Allowing customer/3rd-party tests requires signoff. We'll need: schedule, allowed IPs, test account creds, agreed blast radius, and proof of insured tester. No destructive tests. Also we'll require a post-test remediation SLA.
sophie (solutions): Operational checklist for team: - provide SOC2 summary + pen-test posture doc - generate sample prompt eval harness (see snippet) - enable prefix/KV caching to hit latency targets - provide train/test prompt set for Dr. Patel to validate

sophie (solutions): Example eval harness snippet: ```json
{
  "prompts": ["Extract patient name and medication from note..."],
  "metrics": ["P95_latency_ms", "F1_NER", "PII_false_positive_rate"]
}
```
maria (AE): Pricing note: Hosted POC pricing: free test credits up to $10k plus discounted token rate for POC. Private/on-prem will require infra uplift and dedicated engineering time — estimate +$25k setup. Which route do you prefer?
dr.patel (customer): Let's try hosted EU first. If results good, we may move to private for prod. BAA must be signed before we ingest any real PHI.
lina (legal): I'll drop our DPA and a BAA template to you, @dr.patel. Please review and mark any non-starters.
kevin (security): I'll attach SOC2 summary and the last external vuln scan summary to the secure share. Also confirm: no logs exported to third-party analytics during POC unless explicitly whitelisted.
deploy-bot: scheduled-deployment: EU-hosted-poc-config queued for Apr 3 22:00 UTC by jon (sales_eng)
jon (sales_eng): Next steps: 1) @lina please send DPA/BAA drafts to Dr. Patel 2) @kevin share SOC2 + vuln summary link 3) @dr.patel share pen-test scope and test window 4) @sophie produce eval harness and 200-example test set by Mar 30 5) I will finalize the POC quote and credits.
maria (AE): I'll confirm kickoff call Wed Apr 3 11:00 CEST and lock calendar. Thanks all :thumbsup:
